picks.readmeHead:
# The Day Trader skill

11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar.

Free, MIT, no signup, no API key. The tools are plain Python that read free
public data: Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq Trader's symbol lists, SEC EDGAR
and the House Clerk.

One scans thousands of charts for setups. Another tracks breaking news on
every stock you watch. One watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment
to get in, and another sets your stop and your target before you do. And the
craziest one is the Time Machine: before you risk a dollar, it replays the
rest of the session 10,000 times from the stock's own recent bars, plus every
past day the same setup fired, and tells you the honest odds.

And no trade goes through until you say yes. Nothing in this pack can place
an order on its own. Paper trading is the default.

> **Looking for the original Trader skill?** Copy an investor's 13F, the
> stock screener, tax lots and rebalancing live in
> [github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill).
> This repo is its day-trading sequel: the Trader skill v2.

## Install

Paste this into Claude:

```
https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill

install skill
```

Or as a plugin, in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill
/plugin install day-trader-skill@day-trader-skill
```

Claude Code namespaces plugin skills, so installed as a plugin they show up as
`/day-trader-skill:trader-scanner` and so on. Copy the folders instead if you want
plain `/trader-scanner`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill.git
cp -r day-trader-skill/trader-* ~/.claude/skills/
```

Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's
`.claude/skills/`. No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the
top of a chat and it runs as a mode. You lose the Python tools

picks.name: agent-autoloop
picks.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
picks.readmeHead:
# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

![架构图](docs/architecture.svg)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号>
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。

## 一件事怎么转起来

编号和上面的架构图一一对应：

1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。

picks.readmeHead:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

Download  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. On Windows, if you'd rather skip the installer, each release also ships a portable zip — unpack it and run `openidea.exe`. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. picks.readmeHead:
# TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents

Aaron J. Li1, Weijia Xu2, Chandan Singh2, Zixiao Chen3, Jeevana Priya Inala2, Charlotte Siska3,
Acar Tamersoy3, Bin Yu1, Ion Stoica1, Michel Galley2, Jianfeng Gao2

1UC Berkeley   2Microsoft Research   3Microsoft Security

Our measurement on SWE-Bench tasks: 18.4–30.9% lower mean cost across five agent–model combinations, cheaper in all 30 repository × combination cells, and Pass@1 up in 4 of 5. Results
